hypothesis: At epsilon 0.5, the authorized public-cap curvature certificate passes all previously used informativeness gates on a separate natural-client dataset.
decision: Treat the half-scale bounded-logistic result as externally replicated only if every unchanged gate passes.
dataset: UCI MHEALTH, CC BY 4.0, ten volunteers performing twelve activities

design.roles: Twenty hash-selected ordered checkpoint/test subject pairs; the remaining eight subjects are clients.
design.preprocessing: Exclude null-activity rows, retain every tenth labeled row, standardize from the checkpoint subject only, append a bias coordinate, and project each example to norm at most one.
design.model: Multinomial logistic regression trained by deterministic full-batch gradient descent.

information: Certificates use only public feature and clipping bounds and public sample weights. Designated test-subject outcomes, update directions, coalition values, and Shapley values are excluded from construction.
falsification_rule: Any failed gate contradicts the replication hypothesis; no threshold or dataset-specific scale adjustment is permitted after outcomes are opened.
scope: The 20 profiles overlap in their ten subjects and therefore test cross-dataset transfer of the mechanism, not prevalence across independent populations.
